nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.title, j.description, j.category, j.budget_label, j.budget_max_public,
       s.id AS seller_id, s.display_name, s.headline, s.skills, s.categories,
       s.price_floor, s.max_concurrent_jobs, s.delivery_terms,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs x
         WHERE x.seller_id = s.id AND x.status IN ('funded', 'in_progress'))::int AS active_jobs,
       b.id AS bid_id, b.price AS bid_price, b.status::text AS bid_status,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(n.round), 0) FROM negotiation_messages n WHERE n.bid_id = b.id) AS last_round,
       (SELECT n.offered_price FROM negotiation_messages n
         WHERE n.bid_id = b.id AND n.sender = 'buyer_agent'
         ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS buyer_offer,
       (SELECT n.body FROM negotiation_messages n
         WHERE n.bid_id = b.id AND n.sender = 'buyer_agent'
         ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS buyer_message
FROM jobs j
JOIN sellers s ON s.id = $2::uuid
LEFT JOIN bids b ON b.job_id = j.id AND b.seller_id = s.id
WHERE j.id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Load job and seller
nodes.notes: Reads the job, the seller's skills, floor and capacity, and any existing bid and the buyer's last counter-offer.

nodes.name: Can act?
nodes.notes: Skips when the seller already bid, is at capacity, does not serve the category, or negotiation is at 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Skip?
nodes.notes: True: log why and stop. False: ask the model.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Two prompts: a new bid (price, ETA, 1-3 milestones) or an answer to a counter-offer.

nodes.name: Ask LLM
nodes.notes: Calls the lib llm-json sub-workflow: one model call that must return a JSON object with the required keys, or the run fails.

nodes.name: Enforce rules
nodes.notes: Code decides: never below price_floor, milestones always sum to the price, at most 3, ETA 1-30 days.

nodes.name: Is reply?
nodes.notes: True: save a negotiation message. False: save a new bid.

parameters.query:
WITH msg AS (
  INSERT INTO negotiation_messages
    (job_id, bid_id, round, sender, sender_agent_id, body, offered_price)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::smallint, 'seller_agent', $4::uuid, $5, $6::numeric)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE bids SET price = $6::numeric WHERE id = $2::uuid
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM msg) AS message_id;

nodes.name: Save reply
nodes.notes: Inserts negotiation_messages (sender seller_agent) and updates the bid's price.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bids (job_id, seller_id, placed_by_agent_id, price, delivery_eta, note,
                  proposed_milestones, status)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::numeric, ($5 || ' days')::interval, $6, $7::jsonb,
       'pending_check'
WHERE $8 = 'bid'
ON CONFLICT (job_id, seller_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Save bid
nodes.notes: Inserts bids with status pending_check. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING: one bid per seller per job.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
